## Checklist / 检查清单

<!-- Check only verified items. Explain non-applicable items above. -->

- [ ] The PR is focused; substantial changes were discussed first.
- [ ] Applicable checks passed; validation limitations are documented.
- [ ] Changed behavior has tests, or the absence of a realistic test is explained.
- [ ] Affected English and Chinese documentation is synchronized.
- [ ] No credentials, local configuration, or generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] Release versions/tags are unchanged, unless explicitly requested by a maintainer.
